projects.title: Neuro Move
projects.category: Full-Stack Android app with AI integration
projects.description: NeuroMove is a application for pediatric movement screening. It guides users through onboarding, child profile setup, movement recording, scan processing, analytical results, action plans, and app settings.
projects.role: Full-stack developer — designed the Laravel API and built the Flutter app with deep learning integration
projects.alt: Dark dashboard interface with glowing blue data charts on black background, atmospheric studio lighting
highlights: End-to-end pediatric movement screening — from onboarding through AI-powered analysis to actionable plans
Custom deep learning model for automated movement recording and scan processing
Role-based flows for both parents and clinicians within a single application
Child profile management with longitudinal growth tracking and personalized action plans
features: Onboarding flow for parents and clinicians
Child profile management with growth tracking
AI-powered movement recording and analysis
Automated scan processing with real-time feedback
Custom action plan generation based on results

projects.title: Hospital Management System
projects.description: A full-stack hospital management platform built across three repositories: a Laravel REST API backend, a Flutter desktop app for admins and doctors, and a Flutter mobile app for patients. Supports patient registration, doctor discovery, appointment booking, and role-based dashboards, secured with Sanctum and JWT-based authentication.
projects.role: Full-stack developer — designed the Laravel API and built both the Flutter desktop and mobile clients
projects.alt: Hospital management system dashboard showing patient appointments and doctor management
highlights: Dual-frontend architecture — one Laravel API serving a Flutter desktop app (staff) and a Flutter mobile app (patients)
Token-based authentication with Sanctum on the backend and secure JWT storage via flutter_secure_storage on mobile
Real-time doctor search/filter, animated appointment carousel, and staggered list animations on the patient dashboard
Admin dashboard with visual analytics (charts/bar graphs) for hospital-wide statistics
features: Patient mobile app — registration, doctor discovery, appointment booking, profile management
Admin/doctor desktop app — dashboard, appointment scheduling, patient management, analytics
Laravel REST API with Sanctum token-based authentication and MySQL database
Multi-step registration with inline validation and JWT token management
Animated dashboard with appointment carousel, status indicators, and staggered list animations

projects.title: Social Media
projects.category: Full-stack social media backend with MongoDB
projects.description: A social media backend built with Laravel and MongoDB, using a single-document data structure for efficient reads. Features user authentication, post creation, commenting, likes, and admin management — all stored in a single Data collection with nested arrays for users, posts, comments, and admin entities.
projects.role: Full-stack developer — designed the Laravel API with MongoDB single-document pattern, Sanctum auth, and Blade templating
projects.alt: Social media platform dashboard showing user management and post feed
highlights: Single-document MongoDB pattern — all entities stored in one collection for efficient reads
Role-based authentication with Laravel Sanctum for users and admins
Full CRUD for users, posts, comments with nested array manipulation
Blade-based admin dashboard for user and content management
features: User registration and authentication (admin + regular users)
Post creation, viewing, and deletion with like/comment support
Comment system nested under posts with user attribution
Admin panel for user and content management
MongoDB single-document architecture for optimized read performance

projects.title: My Store
projects.description: A cross-platform management store application built with Flutter and Laravel, featuring a clean architecture approach. Includes a real-time dashboard, customer/invoice/product CRUD, admin role management, statistics with charts, real-time notifications, and multilingual support (English, Arabic, French) with light/dark theme toggle.
projects.role: Full-stack developer — built the Flutter cross-platform client and the Laravel headless backend API
projects.alt: Store management dashboard with analytics charts, invoices, and product stock overview
highlights: Clean Architecture pattern (domain/data/presentation) with get_it DI and flutter_bloc state management
Real-time notifications via Pusher WebSocket broadcasting for low-stock alerts and system events
PDF invoice generation with Arabic and French RTL support using the pdf and printing packages
Multi-role admin system with invite codes, email verification, and Sanctum token authentication
Automated Google Drive backups via Spatie Backup for database and file system
features: Real-time dashboard with metrics, charts, recent orders, and quick actions
Customer CRUD with search, filtering, and detailed profiles
Invoice creation, payment tracking, PDF export (Arabic & French), and archiving
Product stock management with category filtering, photo management, and low-stock alerts
Admin user management with role-based access (main_admin only)
Statistics with revenue, bill counts, stock valuation, and period-based analysis
Real-time notifications with read/unread filtering
Settings with theme toggle, multilingual support, password/email changes, and invite code generation

projects.title: Mzab Community
projects.description: A Windows desktop population registry and community management application built with Flutter, designed for administrative bodies in the M'zab region of Algeria. Features token-based authentication, a dashboard with animated gauges, multi-criteria search and browse, comprehensive resident forms, and interactive statistics charts.
projects.role: Full-stack developer — built the Flutter desktop application with Provider state management and Dio HTTP client
projects.alt: Mzab Community desktop application with Arabic RTL dashboard showing population statistics and animated gauges
highlights: Token-based authentication with secure token persistence via flutter_secure_storage
Multi-criteria search and filtering across family, marital status, gender, profession, education, and birth date
Interactive statistics charts for births, deaths, divorces/widows, and orphans using fl_chart
Full Arabic (RTL) interface with Amiri, Lemonada, and Akshar Google Fonts typography
Dark/light mode theme switching support
features: Token-based login with secure token persistence
Dashboard with family counts, registered people, new additions, and animated gauges
Multi-criteria filtering (family, marital status, gender, profession, education, birth date)
Comprehensive add/edit resident form covering personal, social, and health data
Interactive charts for births, deaths, divorces/widows, and orphans
Dark / light mode theme switching
